description: This file defines a higher-order operator class for calling AOTInductor lowered modules within PyTorch, including implementations for different modes such as ProxyTorchDispatchMode, FakeTensorMode, and functionalization. It manages tracing, fallthroughs, and execution of the delegate call.

classes.name: AOTICallDelegate
classes.description: A higher-order operator class for delegating calls to AOTInductor lowered modules, supporting various execution modes.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Executes the delegate call with provided lowered module, original graph, and tensor arguments.
